stemBlocks: Two light wires P and Q support a load of weight $W$ in equilibrium as shown. Wire P is horizontal and wire Q is at an angle of $60^\circ$ to the vertical. The wires are made from the same material. The radius of wire Q is twice the radius of wire P.
What is the ratio $\frac{\text{strain in wire P}}{\text{strain in wire Q}}$? (The wires do not exceed their limits of proportionality.)
